model: selected per horizon from xgb_depth1, xgb_depth2, logistic_l2, logistic_l2_strong
universe_label: NusaQuant Liquid IDX Universe (market cap > IDR 1T)

limitations.survivorship_bias: The Sectors universe reflects securities available today, so companies delisted during the study period are absent and historical performance is biased upward.
limitations.reporting_lag: A flat 90-day lag stands in for the real publication date, which the API does not reliably expose.
limitations.overlapping_targets: Consecutive quarterly observations share most of their forward window, so the effective sample is smaller than the row count.
limitations.market_factor: The target is the sign of an absolute return, and over 6-12 months that sign is dominated by the direction of the market rather than by anything specific to the company. Per-quarter base rates in this panel range from 0.00 to 1.00. Cross-sectional fundamentals carry no information about the market's own direction, which caps how well any model built on them can score.
limitations.cross_section_width: Fifteen tickers means each quarterly cross-section is fifteen points wide. Widening the universe adds far more effective sample than adding history to the same names.
